career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risk is not AI but instability plus digital doubles. Effects absorb extra work, and people without credits or recognizability have the hardest time.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this job is not AI but instability plus digital doubles. Bookings come in fragments, auditions are fiercely competitive, and motion capture and generative effects are starting to absorb stand-ins and extras, though lead-level performance still rests with people.
risks: Unstable bookings
Fierce audition competition
Digital doubles absorb extras
Highly polarized income
Heavy emotional drain

page.contract_project_risk_block: However clever the effects get, which scene calls for tears, which reaction rings truest, and how the character stands up still come from the actor's head, body, and heart. On the performance end, people cannot be pulled out cleanly.

responsibilities: Work the shoot and the performance

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「不稳定 + 数字替身」——群演被特效吃，没作品没辨识度的人最难熬。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「不稳定性 + 数字替身」——档期零碎、试镜竞争激烈，动作捕捉与生成式特效开始吃掉替身与群演，但主角级表演仍靠人。
risks: 档期不稳定
试镜竞争大
数字替身吃群演
收入两极分化
情绪消耗大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管特效多聪明，哪场戏该哭、哪个反应最真、角色怎么立，最后还是演员的脑去想、身去演、心去交——表演这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are zero tolerance for error + heavy responsibility, not AI. Intraoperative deviations endanger life, while people retain decisions.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is zero tolerance for error + heavy responsibility. Any intraoperative deviation can endanger life, while people still make decisions.
risks: High-risk work with zero tolerance for error
Intraoperative emergencies
Long training period
Night shifts and consecutive cases
Immense responsibility

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, anesthesiologists still decide which dose to increase, which sign to interpret, and which emergency to treat. People must see, adjust, and carry responsibility. They cannot be fully removed from anesthesia.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「零容错 + 高责任」——术中偏差危及生命，但决策仍靠人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「零容错 + 高责任」——术中一丝偏差就危及生命，但决策仍靠人。
risks: 零容错高危
术中突发
培养周期长
夜班连台
责任极大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪量该加、哪征该判、哪突发该处，最后还是麻醉医的眼睛去看、手去调、责去担——麻醉这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Dual pressure from results and injuries
Early planning makes the transition easier
The transition gap is most difficult

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk for athletes is not AI but short careers and injury. AI can extend careers and reduce injuries; the decisive factors are managing the body and building a second path before retirement.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest employment risk is not AI but short careers and injury. Most athletes have only a few peak years, and injury can end a career instantly. Competition at the top of the pyramid is fierce, most participants earn far less than their visibility suggests, and short careers and difficult transitions are widespread.
risks: Short career: only a few peak years
Injury risk: one major injury can end a career
Brutal selection: very few reach the top of the pyramid
Income disparity: most do not earn high incomes
Difficult transition: skills are hard to transfer after retirement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate what to train and how to recover, but it cannot help once the whistle sounds. The jump, the shot, and the split-second choice must come from the athlete's body and will.

responsibilities: Analyze opponents and review personal performance
Cooperate with physical management and rehabilitation
Manage competitive form and professional conduct

career_risk_cards.callout: 运动员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「职业寿命的短与伤」——AI 反而在帮你延长生涯、减少伤病；真正决定这行去留的，是你能不能管理好身体、并在退役前把第二条路铺好。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业生涯的短与伤」：多数运动员的巅峰期只有几年，伤病可能瞬间终结职业生涯；同时行业金字塔顶端竞争惨烈，绝大多数从业者的收入远低于曝光度，职业寿命短、转型难是普遍问题。
risks: 职业生涯短：巅峰期只有几年
伤病风险：一次重伤可能终结生涯
淘汰残酷：金字塔顶端极少
收入悬殊：多数人拿不到高收入
转型困难：退役后技能转换难

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算出你该练什么、怎么恢复，但比赛哨响的那一刻，机器帮不了你——那一下起跳、那一脚射门、那一瞬间的选择，只能由你的身体和意志去完成。

responsibilities: 执行专项训练并参加比赛
分析对手与复盘自身表现
配合身体管理与康复恢复
管理竞技状态与职业行为

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone but the combination of automation and compliance. Systems absorb routine sampling, while people who analyze data and understand compliance remain more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main occupational risks come from automated monitoring stations and sensors. Systems absorb routine sampling and readings while compliance standards become stricter, but people remain essential for field sampling design, anomaly interpretation, and health-related judgment.
risks: Automated stations absorb routine sampling
Sensor replacement
Stricter compliance standards
Difficult field conditions
Fatigue from repetitive records

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable instruments become, technicians still choose sampling locations, interpret anomalies, and connect environmental conditions with health. Environmental monitoring cannot remove human observation, judgment, and communication.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化 + 合规」——常规采样被系统吃，会分析懂合规的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要来自自动监测站与传感器——常规采样和读数被系统吃，且合规口径趋严；但现场布点、异常研判与健康关联判断仍要人。
risks: 自动站吃常规采样
传感器替代
合规口径趋严
现场作业辛苦
重复记录疲劳

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管仪器多聪明，布点怎么选、异常怎么判、健康怎么关联，最后还是技术员的眼去读、脑去判、嘴去讲——环境这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but relying only on strength. AGVs and robotic arms move standard goods; workers who operate forklifts, collaborate with equipment, and cover multiple roles can withstand the automation transition.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are automation equipment and workplace injury. Automated sorting lines, AGVs, and robotic arms reduce purely manual movement each year, while heavy handling carries substantial injury risk. Workers who operate forklifts, collaborate with equipment, and cover multiple roles are more secure.
risks: Heavy-load handling has high injury risk and can damage the lower back
AGVs and robotic arms reduce purely manual roles
Piece-rate earnings fluctuate between peak and slow seasons
Peak seasons bring extensive overtime and physical strain
Limited skills restrict advancement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AGVs and robotic arms move more every year, but narrow aisles, urgent orders, and irregular goods still depend on a worker bending down to handle them. Logistics rewards efficiency: machines move standard items and people resolve the remaining edge cases.

responsibilities: Load and unload vehicles and palletize goods
Work alongside equipment and maintain safety

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会出力气」——AGV 和机械臂会搬走标准件，会开叉车、懂设备协作、能顶多工种的搬运工，才扛得住自动化转型。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「自动化设备 + 工伤风险」——自动分拣线、AGV、机械臂逐年普及，纯人力搬运量在减少；而重物搬运的工伤风险高，会操作叉车、懂设备协作、能适应多工种的搬运工更稳。
risks: 重物搬运工伤风险高，腰椎易损伤
AGV 与机械臂减少纯人力岗位
计件收入波动，旺季淡季差异
旺季加班多，体力消耗大
技能单一，晋升空间有限

page.contract_project_risk_block: AGV 和机械臂搬得越来越多，但窄巷道、急单、异形货，还得靠你弯腰的那一下——物流是「效率」的行业，机器搬标准件，人处理剩下的边角。

responsibilities: 配合设备作业并维护安全

career_path_block.说明: Two years of service, foundation for transformation
High development ceiling and greater responsibility
Planning well is an advantage, being haphazard is a pitfall

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest professional risk is not AI, but "the uncertainty of the real battlefield" - this is one of the few professions that requires facing the risk of life and death, and you must think clearly before choosing.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in the job is "war and training accidents" - this is the only occupation with the highest risk on the real battlefield. In peacetime, there are also training injuries, physical and mental exhaustion in the station and field environment, and after the service period, you have to face the transition problem of secondary employment.
risks: Battlefield Risks: Casualty Risks in Real Combat
Training Injuries: Strain Injuries from High-Intensity Training
Disciplinary restrictions: personal freedoms are greatly restricted
Family separation: stationed on training duty and away from home all year round
Transition Dilemma: Secondary Employment after Retirement

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can allow infantry to see farther and shoot more accurately, but the courage and trust behind the sentence "Follow me" on the battlefield can never be calculated by the algorithm.

responsibilities: Perform ground combat and training missions
Operation and maintenance of individual equipment
Implement combat readiness and internal affairs disciplines

career_path_block.说明: 规划好是优势，随意是坑

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「真实战场的不确定性」——这是少数需要直面生死风险的职业，选择之前必须想清楚。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「战争与训练事故」——这是唯一一个真实战场风险最高的职业之一；和平时期也有训练伤病、驻地和野战环境的身心消耗，服役期满还要面对二次就业的转型难题。
risks: 战场风险：真实作战的伤亡风险
训练伤病：高强度训练的劳损
纪律约束：个人自由大幅受限
家庭分离：驻训执勤常年在外
转型难题：退役后的二次就业

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能让步兵看得更远、打得更准，但阵地上一句「跟我上」背后的勇气和信任，永远是算法算不出来的。

responsibilities: 执行地面作战与训练任务

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but remaining on conventional machines without learning CNC. As AI grows stronger, machinists who can program, understand processes, and produce precision parts become more valuable.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but the technical threshold created by the transition to CNC. Automation reduces basic conventional-machine operator roles, while major shortages persist in advanced fields such as five-axis machining and moldmaking. Machinists who can program CNC equipment, understand processes, and produce high-precision parts become increasingly valuable.
risks: CNC automation reduces basic operator roles.
Skills evolve quickly; those who stop learning fall behind.
Workshop noise and oil exposure create occupational-health risks.
Piece-rate pressure and frequent overtime
Industry cycles affect order volumes.

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can automatically generate CNC programs and optimize cutting parameters, but setup feel, tool-setting precision, and judgment when tolerances are exceeded still depend on experienced machinists. Machining is a craft of metal and precision: machines provide measurements, but people understand what it takes to remain within tolerance.

responsibilities: Set up and machine parts according to drawings
Operate CNC and conventional machine tools
skills: Use of measuring instruments and dimensional inspection

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「停在普通机床不学数控」——会编程、懂工艺、能做精密件的师傅，AI 越强越值钱。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数控化转型的技术门槛」——基础手动机床操作员被自动化压缩，但五轴加工、模具制造等高端方向缺口大；会数控编程、懂工艺、能做高精度件的师傅反而越来越值钱。
risks: 基础操作岗被数控自动化压缩
技能更新快，不学就落伍
车间噪音油污，职业健康风险
计件压力，加班常见
行业景气波动影响订单

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动生成数控程序、优化切削参数，但装夹的手感、对刀的精度、超差时的判断，还得靠老师傅。机械加工是「铁和精度」的活，公差内的毫米，机器给不了，人心里有数。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but remaining at the basic-helper level. Replacing light bulbs and clearing drains alone limits pay and advancement. Integrated maintenance and specialized refrigeration or low-voltage credentials provide the path from helper to versatile maintenance engineer.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risks are plumbing and electrical safety plus skill breadth, not AI. Energized work, elevated work, and sewage pipes all carry hazards. The broad repair scope requires some knowledge of everything, while deeper specialties such as refrigeration and low-voltage systems require separate credentials.
risks: Operational safety: energized work, elevated work, and sewage hazards
Broad but shallow skills: limited competitiveness and pay
Emergency pressure: on call for late-night repairs
Physical demands: constant movement, lifting, and carrying
Career path: advancement is difficult without credentials

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can infer seven out of ten faults from a repair description, but when a top-floor resident reports fluctuating water pressure, you still have to inspect floor by floor and test repeatedly to determine whether the cause is the meter, a valve, or a leak inside the wall. This on-site craft explains why maintenance workers remain essential.

responsibilities: Resolve facility faults and make minor repairs
Record work orders and support specialist trades
skills: Plumbing and electrical repair and inspection
Pipe, door, window, and lock repair
Work order and spare parts management

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技能停在杂工层面」——只会换灯泡、通下水道，薪酬和晋升都有限。往综合维保、专项证书（制冷、弱电）走，才能从「杂工」变成「全能维修工程师」。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「电工水工安全与技能广度」——带电作业、登高作业、污水管道都有风险；且维修范围杂，什么都要会一点，深入的专业（如制冷、弱电）要另行考证。
risks: 作业安全：带电、登高、污水风险
技能杂而不深：竞争与薪酬受限
突发压力：半夜报修随叫随到
体力消耗：常年跑动搬抬
职业路径：不考证难晋升

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能根据报修描述猜出七成故障，但顶楼那户「水压忽大忽小」的问题，是水表、阀门还是墙里漏水，还得你一层层查、一次次试——这份现场功夫，是维修工存在的理由。

responsibilities: 记录工单并配合专业工种

career_path_block.说明: Reduced by automation of records and triage

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but responsibility. AI can suggest differential diagnoses, but you still sign the prescription and remain accountable to the patient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI but responsibility and workload. Independent practice means independent accountability for missed and incorrect diagnoses. Primary-care roles handle many patients at a fast pace, sometimes without time even to drink water.
risks: Practice responsibility: accountability for independent diagnosis and prescribing
Work intensity: high patient volumes and fast pace in primary care
System limitations: independent prescribing authority has not yet opened in China
Advanced-study pressure: long-term investment in graduate education and certification
Burnout: depletion from repetitive high workloads

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can write polished records and send timely reminders, but the clinical intuition to judge whether a patient's condition is acceptable today comes from caring for patients one by one.

responsibilities: Provide chronic-disease management and health education
Identify referral cases and collaborate on care

career_path_block.说明: 被病历与分诊自动化压缩

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任」——AI 能给你鉴别诊断建议，但最终签下处方、对患者负责的，还是你自己。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任与工作量」——独立执业意味着独立担责，误诊漏诊的风险要自己扛；基层岗位患者多、节奏快，忙起来连喝水的时间都没有。
risks: 执业责任：独立诊断与处方的担责风险
工作强度：基层接诊量大、节奏快
制度限制：国内独立处方权尚未放开
进修压力：读研与认证的长期投入
职业倦怠：重复性高负荷的消耗

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能替你把病历写工整、把提醒发准时，但「这个患者今天的状态到底行不行」的临床直觉，是靠一个个患者喂出来的。

responsibilities: 接诊并评估患者健康状况
开具处方与调整治疗方案
实施慢病管理与健康宣教
识别转诊病例并协作处理

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but imbalance between workload and rewards. Pediatricians who persist are precisely the scarcest and most needed.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI, but workload and physician-patient pressure. High outpatient volume, emergency night shifts, parental anxiety, occupational exposure, and compensation that fails to match pediatricians' effort drive talent loss.
risks: High clinic and emergency intensity with frequent burnout
Pediatric compensation does not match effort, with low performance pay
Physician-patient pressure and dispute risk
Emergency night shifts and occupational exposure
Talent loss creates heavier workloads and a vicious cycle

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can write records, interpret images, and provide prompts, but when a child cannot speak, you still distinguish a cold from pneumonia and decide the medication dose and how to explain it to parents. This is why pediatricians are irreplaceable and why the profession matters.

responsibilities: Develop treatment plans and guide medication use
Provide child health services and communicate conditions
skills: Pediatric history taking and physical examinations

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「强度与回报的失衡」——但坚持下来的儿科医生，恰恰是最稀缺、最被需要的人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「工作强度与医患压力」——门诊量大、夜班急诊、家长焦虑情绪、职业暴露，以及儿科医生收入与付出不匹配导致的人才流失。
risks: 门诊与急诊强度大，职业倦怠高发
儿科收入与付出不匹配，绩效偏低
医患压力与纠纷风险
夜班急诊与职业暴露
人才流失导致负荷更重，恶性循环

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能写病历、读片子、给提示，但面对一个说不出话的孩子，判断「到底是感冒还是肺炎」、决定「用多少药、怎么和家长说」的，还得是你——这是儿科医生的不可替代性，也是这个职业存在的意义。

responsibilities: 制定治疗方案并指导用药

career_path_block.可控: Use AI for speed, shift toward judgment

career_risk_cards.callout: Risk stays manageable as long as you do not overstep your scope and keep learning. The moat for Pile Driver Operators lies in execution and judgment, not repetitive labor.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this role is not AI but medium-risk exposure combined with scope of responsibility. Judgment and final review for Pile Driver Operators still rest with people; AI only handles structurable tasks.
risks: Pressure from responsibility and compliance boundaries in pile driving.
Structurable tasks are being replaced faster by AI.
Industry swings and tighter headcount or posts.
Knowledge turns over quickly and needs constant refreshing.
Communication overhead in cross-role collaboration.

page.contract_project_risk_block: Split moderate risk into what you can learn and what you can control: methods are learnable, process and compliance are controllable.

responsibilities: Develop and execute pile-driving work plans.
Take responsibility for the quality and risks of pile-driving results.
Coordinate resources and drive delivery of pile-driving projects.
Review and improve pile-driving processes and methods.

skills.说明: Use AI and professional software well

career_path_block.可控: 用 AI 提效、转向判断

career_risk_cards.callout: 风险可控的前提是「不越责任边界 + 持续补课」——打桩机操作员的护城河在执行与判断，不在重复劳动。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不在 AI，而在「中风险敞口 + 责任边界」——打桩机操作员的判断与终审仍由人承担，AI 只处理可结构化任务。
risks: Pile Driver Operators领域的责任与合规边界压力。
可结构化任务被 AI 加速替代。
行业波动与编制/岗位收紧。
知识更新快，需持续补课。
跨角色协作的沟通成本。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 把中风险拆成「可学 + 可控」两块：可学的是方法，可控的是流程与合规。

responsibilities: 制定与执行Pile Driver Operators相关的工作方案。
对Pile Driver Operators产出质量与风险负责。
协调资源、推动Pile Driver Operators项目交付。
复盘优化Pile Driver Operators流程与方法。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but work at height + physical demands. Prefabrication moves some tying into factories, and workers limited to manual handling are easiest to replace.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this job is not AI, but working at height, falls, and physical wear. Long periods bent over tying rebar strain the lower back, elevated work creates fall hazards, and prefabrication is moving some on-site tying into factories.
risks: Fall hazards from elevated work
Back strain from prolonged bending
Prefabrication reduces on-site work
Large fluctuations in physical workload
Penalties for safety violations

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how smart software becomes, people still determine how each bar bends around obstacles, how it is tied at height, and how joints are finished. Human hands tie it, eyes inspect it, and minds take responsibility. People cannot be fully removed from building a structure's bones.

responsibilities: Lay out rebar according to plan
